Use @Image1 as the first frame. Keep the cyan-tinted young woman (knit beanie, denim jacket), the orange rounded-square panel, pink cartoon lightning bolts, and the bright blue collage field. Youthful indie-animator title-sequence energy — hand-made graphic motion, playful and stylish — not dark, not horror. The ringed planet stays a tiny background sticker only; never cut to a planet-only insert.

SHOT ONE (0–1.5s), poster wide: collage elements wake up — pink bolts jitter then stretch longer, orange panel does a soft squash-and-stretch pulse, blue field gets a subtle grain shimmer; she starts a snappy in-place quarter-turn as the camera arcs left→front with a micro Dutch tilt. HARD CUT.

SHOT TWO (1.5–3.2s), fashion medium: she continues the turn (feet planted), beanie bobbles, denim catches a light sweep; lightning bolts orbit her shoulders like stickers peeling and re-sticking; camera punches in then pulls a half-step with a playful whip. Identity locked to @Image1. HARD CUT.

SHOT THREE (3.2–5s), hero close-medium: she faces lens, chin pops up, micro-smile; both bolts flash in sync then settle as bold graphic accents; orange panel does one final pop-scale; hold on HER — no cutaway plates.

Audio: lo-fi indie synth ticks, paper/sticker rustle whooshes, sparkle hits on lightning, soft chime on final pop. No dialogue, no lyrics, no text overlays, no black frames.

## Input Asset

- [api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_2_i2v_input.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_2_i2v_input.png)

## Gemini Omni: image to video

Gemini Omni Flash renders picture and sound in one pass, so ambience, effects and voices come out of the same clip — there is no separate audio step. Connect a still to `Load Image` and the prompt can call it `@Image1`: it becomes the first frame, and the prompt carries what happens next.

- `model` — Omni Flash 1.2. Omni Flash 1.1 stays available for a transition window; requests route to 1.2 from 2026-12-03.
- `resolution` / `aspect_ratio` — `720p` and `16:9` as shipped.
- `task` — `image_to_video`; switch to `text_to_video` when there is no reference image.
- Same seed gives a similar take, not an identical one.
